newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan's Kubo says may unveil MOF reform idea.
newsitem.headline: Japan's Kubo says may unveil MOF reform idea.

text.p: Japan's Finance Minister Wataru Kubo said on Wednesday he may unveil the results of his ministry's study on how to reform itself at a news conference scheduled for 0730 GMT.
"If possible I would like to unveil the results of the ministry's study on how to reform itself at a news conference later today with my own statement," Kubo told a group of businessmen.
The Ministry of Finance (MOF) has set up a task force of senior bureaucrats to study how to reform itself in an attempt to forestall heavy political pressure to curb its power.
